summary.ko: 에셋 이름·변형·내보내기 사양·사용 권한을 추적 가능한 인계 목록으로 정리합니다.
summary.en: Organize design assets into a traceable handoff with naming, export specifications, and rights notes.

exclusions: General project closeout without design assets

required_inputs.description: Asset inventory and source files or metadata
Intended platforms, recipient needs, and required formats

workflow.instruction: Inventory source and output assets and map each to its destination and intended use.
Define consistent filenames, scale variants, dimensions, color modes, and transparency requirements.
Check missing states, duplicate or outdated variants, and licensing or attribution notes against available evidence.
Prepare an export manifest and recipient checklist; verify actual outputs when export tools are available.

deliverables.name: Asset manifest
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each asset has source, destination, filename, format, dimensions, variant, and rights status

deliverables.name: Handoff instructions
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Explains usage, missing items, and verification status

limitations: A manifest does not mean files were exported or uploaded.
Unknown rights must remain unknown rather than being labeled free to use.
permission_boundaries: Do not change sharing permissions, delete originals, or transfer files to clients without authorization.
Do not redistribute font files or licensed assets beyond their permitted scope.
